concept: Global Accelerator: static anycast IPs for TCP/UDP
tests: Choosing a service for a TCP game with static anycast IPs, global network acceleration and fast regional failover.
expected: AWS Global Accelerator — 2 static anycast IPs, traffic over the AWS backbone, failover within seconds. Triggers: "TCP/UDP", "static anycast IP", "gaming", "fast regional failover".
why_not: CloudFront caches HTTP content; Route 53 — DNS only (TTL-dependent failover); NLB in one region with no global acceleration.
